title: signstudy: DTW versus learned models for isolated sign recognition from hand landmarks (code, pre-registration and aggregate results)
description: Code, pre-registration (PREREG.md, PREREG_ADDENDUM.md), aggregate results and paper sources for a study comparing nearest-neighbour dynamic time warping with learned models for isolated sign recognition on PopSign ASL v1.0 and ASL Citizen. Isolated-sign recognition only; not translation; no claim about benefit to Deaf users. ASL Citizen derived data are not included (licence).
notes: Creator details confirmed by the author (ORCID supplied 2026-10-07).
